nodes.description: Owned.owner: address holding contract ownership, initialized from msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner guard.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
GT.symbol public string, set to 'GT' in the constructor.
GT.name public string, set to 'General Token' in the constructor.
GT.decimals public uint8, set to 8 in the constructor.
GT._totalSupply: fixed token supply computed in the constructor with an unchecked multiplication.
GT.balances: mapping(address => uint) holding token balances, written by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
GT.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding allowances, written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b): checked addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b): checked division requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the initial privileged account.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then completes the ownership handover.
GT constructor: sets token metadata, computes the fixed supply with an unchecked multiplication, and mints the whole supply to owner.
GT.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
GT.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
GT.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
GT.approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval (classic approval race).
GT.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and the msg.sender allowance, credits balances[to].
GT.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
GT.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then performs an external call into the arbitrary spender contract.
GT fallback function: payable but always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
GT.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue that performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller used for ownership, balance keys and allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token address.
Unchecked arithmetic 10000000000 * 10**uint(decimals) evaluated without SafeMath in the GT constructor.

edges.reason: Owned constructor reads msg.sender to initialize the owner account.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
GT constructor reads owner to assign the initial supply balance.
GT constructor sets symbol.
GT constructor sets name.
GT constructor sets decimals.
GT constructor performs the unchecked multiplication 10000000000 * 10**uint(decimals).
Unchecked multiplication result is stored directly into _totalSupply.
GT constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares msg.sender with owner.
transferOwnership writes the parameter into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before handing over ownership.
acceptOwnership moves newOwner into owner, completing the privilege transfer.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
totalSupply delegates subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the balances mapping key.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
transfer uses the to parameter as the credited balance key.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the transferred amount.
transfer subtracts from the sender balance via SafeMath.sub.
transfer adds to the recipient balance via SafeMath.add.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping.
approve keys the allowance by msg.sender.
approve uses the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve uses the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited balance/allowance key.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credited balance key.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the transferred amount.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for both accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the outer allowed key.
allowance uses spender as the inner allowed key.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender.
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter as allowance key and external callee.
approveAndCall uses the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
approveAndCall forwards the opaque data parameter to the callee.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall reaches an external call into an attacker-supplied spender contract from the token logic.
The callee receiveApproval callback executes while approveAndCall is still on the stack, allowing reentrant entry.
An attacker-controlled spender can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback using the freshly granted allowance.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token compares msg.sender with owner.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the owner address.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.

The tokenOwner argument is a transient lookup key used only inside allowance.

The spender argument drives both the allowance write and the unsafe external call inside approveAndCall.
